messages:
erin: Drafting a lightweight partner SEV play for cloud marketplace partners (short, practical). dropping the skeleton here for quick sign-off.

matt: pls include channel naming + PD mapping. keep it minimal.

erin: skeleton -> 1) auto-create ephemeral channel on SEV PD alert `#pmkt-<partner>-sev-<YYYYMMDD>` 2) bot invites: partners-liaison, ops-oncall, partner-tech 3) ack window: 10m (bot posts at 5m & 9m) 4) fallback: region failover or model-variant; ops executes rollback if needed 5) handback: postmortem owner rule (see below) 6) retention: 7 days, sensitive logs via secure transfer only.

sofia: add marketing/announce step for joint customers? sometimes partners want to coord public comms.

erin: added: if customer-visible outage >30m, liaison drafts joint statement within 60m. legal-review will pre-approve template during onboarding.

matt: how do we pick postmortem owner?

erin: rule: if cause on partner infra -> partner lead; if cause on our runtime/model -> redwood lead; if mixed -> joint author. we'll capture this decision in the channel and set owner tag.

partners-bot: created channel `#pmkt-nimbus-sev-20250214` and invited partners-liaison, ops-oncall, @nimbus-tech

sofia: tiny ops ask: bot should apply a `create_channel` flag from partner profile so only authorized partners get ephemeral channels.

erin: done. set default false; onboarding must enable. also adding CSV template for PD ids & pager.

matt: can we run a weekly audit of open partner SEV channels? prevent leakage.

erin: yes bot will generate weekly report and email partnerships. schedule added.

legal-review: please ensure the retention and data-transfer notes are acceptable; else flag for edits.

sofia: looks good to me. ready to move into playbook.

erin: thanks all 44d i'll push to partnerships repo and notify onboarding team.
